lines: 研究用的电脑，\n还是不要随便乱碰的好。
塞满了关于宝可梦的书。
一本晦涩难懂的书。

Prof. Birch is studying the habitats
and distribution of Pokémon.{be01}
The Prof enjoys May’s help, too.
There’s a lot of love there.

Prof. Birch is studying the habitats
and distribution of Pokémon.{be01}
The Prof enjoys Brendan’s help, too.
There’s a lot of love there.
Prof. Birch: While you’re at it, why not\ngive a nickname to that {0101:1}?

Prof. Birch: Great!
May should be happy, too.{be01}
Get May to teach you what it
means to be a Trainer.

Prof. Birch: Great!
Brendan should be happy, too.{be01}
Get Brendan to teach you what it
means to be a Trainer.
小田卷博士：别这么说嘛，\n去见见我家孩子！

Prof. Birch: May should be on
Route 103 somewhere.{be01}
If you or your Pokémon get tired,
get some rest at home.

Prof. Birch: Brendan should be on
Route 103 somewhere.{be01}
If you or your Pokémon get tired,
get some rest at home.
看上去是个很先进的机器，\n一定是博士做研究时用的。
{0100:0}得到了宝可梦图鉴！

小遥：哇，{0100:0}！
你也拿到宝可梦图鉴啦！{be01}
太好了！和我一样！
这个送给你！

Brendan: Huh...
So you got a Pokédex, too.{be01}
Well then, here.
I’ll give you this.
呀，你的包包满了。
喂，你的包包满了。

小田卷博士：前面还有无数的宝可梦
在等着你！{be01}
啊——
我又想去做实地调查了！
小遥：接下来该去\n哪里找宝可梦呢？
Brendan: Where should I look for\nPokémon next...
小田卷博士：好，升级完成啦！
{0100:0}的宝可梦图鉴升级成了\n全国模式！
All right! Your first Pokémon will\ncome out and walk with you.
I see. Come and talk to me if\nyou change your mind.
Your first Pokémon is enjoying\nthe walk.{be01}\nShould it go back in its Poké Ball?
All right. Your first Pokémon\nwill rest in its Poké Ball now.
Good! Then keep walking together.

小田卷博士：这是只有在其它地区
才能找到的稀有宝可梦！{be01}
从这3只中
挑1只吧！
要给刚得到的\n{0100:1}起昵称吗？
没有地方放这只宝可梦了。
